name: Allan Reyes
headline: Designer & Visual Director — brand, product and content
intro: 20 years across brand, visual identity, marketing and digital product. I take a brief to a visual direction and carry it through to production, from concept to code, with AI as part of my creative process.
profile: Designer with 20 years of experience across brand, visual identity, marketing and digital product. I take a brief to a visual direction and carry it through to production, from concept to code. I run Ulam Pinoy, a food channel and website with 66.4K subscribers and 11.3M views. AI is part of my creative process, from research and moodboards to design systems and event production.
